commentary.text: 90+7' Gianluca Manganiello is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+5' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gianluca Manganiello had an easy-decision to make.
90+4' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

90+4' Golden chance! Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
90+2' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Carnesecchi intercepts the ball.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
89' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
88' Atalanta are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
85' Holy smokes, you don't see that very often! Cristian Chivu gets a second yellow card and has to leave the bench.
84' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Atalanta players aren’t happy.
84' Referee Gianluca Manganiello halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Cristian Chivu, then shows him a yellow.
82' 1 - 1 Goal! Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
82' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
80' It's time for a substitution. Stefan de Vrij (Inter) comes on in place of Manuel Akanji.
80' The linesman raises his flag. Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is adjudged offside.
79' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
78' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
76' Here is a change. Marten de Roon is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta).
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Davide Frattesi (Inter) for Nicolo Barella.
76' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
74' Inter enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
72' The game is interrupted. Marcus Thuram (Inter) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
72' Ederson (Atalanta) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
71' Marcus Thuram (Inter) jumps into a tackle and Gianluca Manganiello signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Atalanta.
70' Atalanta are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
68' Inter spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) comes onto the pitch so that Francesco Pio Esposito can be given a rest.
65' Federico Dimarco will be replaced by Luis Henrique (Inter).
65' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) replaces Nicola Zalewski.
65' Substitution. Isak Hien (Atalanta) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Sead Kolasinac walks off.

64' Henrikh Mkhitaryan slides a brilliant pass into Denzel Dumfries (Inter), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
62' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

61' A pass travels right across the box to Marcus Thuram (Inter) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom right corner, but Marco Carnesecchi denies him with a decent save.
61' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but Yann Sommer comes off his line to gather the ball.
59' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Carlos Augusto (Inter) was quite harsh and Gianluca Manganiello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
58' Inter are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
57' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Atalanta.
55' Neat passing move from Inter in order to create new attacking opportunities.
54' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

54' It looks like Federico Dimarco (Inter) saw red with that tackle. Gianluca Manganiello won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Free kick. Atalanta will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

53' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Atalanta will take a throw-in.
51' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Lazar Samardzic will be replaced by Ederson (Atalanta).
51' It is time for a substitution. Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is on for Gianluca Scamacca.
50' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

49' It looked like the long-range shot by Marcus Thuram (Inter) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
49' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
48' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

48' The Atalanta players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
46' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Petar Sucic.
46' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
43' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
42' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
42' Yann Bisseck (Inter) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
41' Inter control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

39' Marcus Thuram (Inter) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
36' The Atalanta players are exchanging some short passes.
33' Federico Dimarco (Inter) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
33' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
32' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
32' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) but poses no threat.
30' Great teamplay by Atalanta as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

29' Good chance! Federico Dimarco (Inter) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
26' 1 - 0 Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) collects a delightful pass inside the box and nets with a perfect low drive into the middle of the goal. What a clinical finish!
25' Nicolo Barella (Inter) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Carnesecchi, who smothers the ball.
25' 67:33 – the ratio of ball possession.
21' Petar Sucic (Inter) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
21' Gianluca Manganiello shows a yellow card to Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) for his blatant foul.

21' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
19' That's a well-taken pass by Nicolo Barella (Inter). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
18' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
16' Atalanta hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
14' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
11' Inter are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
10' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
9' An attempted cross from Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) is cleared.
8' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.

6' Nicolo Barella swings in an inviting cross that finds Federico Dimarco (Inter). He doesn't take advantage as his effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.

5' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
4' A pass by Federico Dimarco (Inter) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
3' Marcus Thuram (Inter) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
2' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The first half has just begun.
Atalanta will kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello is introduced as the referee for today's match.
